steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Establish base app package definitions and metadata for Expense Tracker Pro.

steps.title: Configure 3D Metallic Header Gradient Background
steps.description: Create header_bg.xml drawable with metallic slate gradients and deep shadow layers for high fidelity 3D style.

steps.title: Establish Raised 3D Card Drawables
steps.description: Create card_bg.xml featuring embossed light surfaces and solid bottom shadow layers to simulate 3D neumorphic sheets.

steps.title: Create Dynamic 3D Gradients for Action Buttons
steps.description: Generate button backgrounds for Income, Expense and Neutral states using realistic double layered gradients with glowing stroke borders.

steps.title: Design App-Open Loading Screen Animation Shape
steps.description: Define loader_circle.xml sweep gradient ring to act as a custom high-quality rotating dynamic spinner on app startup.

steps.title: Formulate Elegant Main Layout with Embedded Loader and Refresh Panel
steps.description: Update activity_main.xml layout with premium 3D cards, customized navigation items, custom pull-to-refresh header block, and absolute full-screen loader overlay panel.

steps.title: Enhance Main Activity Class with App-Open Timer and Progress Tracking
steps.description: Wire the splash loader overlay in MainActivity.java to show an elegant animated loading progress from 0% to 100% before fading out.

steps.title: Build Custom Interactive Pull-to-Refresh Gesture Handler
steps.description: Track native touch events on the Transaction ListView, allowing the user to pull down to stretch open the dynamic loading header with real-time text guidelines.

steps.title: Integrate Programmatic ToneGenerator Sounds
steps.description: Employ Android's audio ToneGenerator to play custom synthesized acoustic pitch-up and pitch-down bleep alerts for drag triggers and complete refresh states.

steps.title: Enhance Custom Chart Drawing with Float Shadows
steps.description: Upgrade ChartView.java custom paint settings to draw realistic soft drop-shadow layers on analytic pie slices, adding premium 3D depth.

steps.title: Verify Strict SDK & Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Review and compile codebase structure with standard Java 8 conventions without modern lambdas or external libraries.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker Pro
steps.description: Assemble debug package with clean compile options.
